cohort: 2120 primiparous women who gave birth to singletons in Tehran, Iran between July 6th and 21st, 2015
finding: The artificial neural network (ANN) method demonstrated the highest accuracy in classifying cesarean section delivery compared to logistic regression and random forest methods, identifying mother's age, socioeconomic status, BMI, baby's head circumference, and infant weight as the most important determinant variables.
